productLaunches.title: Cortex
productLaunches.description: Turn API specs into docs, SDKs, and MCP servers - Cortex is an open source API knowledge layer that turns OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, and OpenRPC specs into interactive documentation, typed SDKs in 11 languages, and MCP servers for AI agents.

productLaunches.title: QApilot MCP for Android
productLaunches.description: Android app testing inside your coding agent - QApilot MCP automates tests on real Android devices and emulators by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Describe a test flow in plain English, no Appium code required. Your agent lays out the steps. QApilot runs the steps. It finds the elements, waits for the screen to settle, retries when something moves, and caches what it learns so repeat runs are faster. Every pass saves a Gherkin feature file and becomes a replayable test case. Needs Node, Java and the Android SDK.

productLaunches.title: ABrush
productLaunches.description: AI Studio for Digital Artists - ABrush brings leading AI models and production-ready advanced AI workflows into the environment where artists already work. We use AI to remove repetitive production work, accelerate iteration, and give artists more time for creative decisions, while keeping the artist in control of the final result. AI speeds up the process and cuts the cost of routine. Created by artists, for artists.

productLaunches.title: Stackness
productLaunches.description: Show your stack! The social home for your dev tools - Stackness is where developers and vibe coders show the tools, workflows, and approaches they build with. Build a stack profile you share as one link, post your moves, follow people whose taste you trust, and watch tools rise and fall. Free and with an MCP server.

productLaunches.title: Work Life Panda
productLaunches.description: Every task, every calendar, one app. Private on-device AI - Your week lives in a calendar, your to-dos in a list, your plans in a group chat. Work Life Panda puts them in one calm place — a real task manager and real calendar, together, starting with the life you already have. Every task and event has its own chat.
